x: A fine race resulted in a win for E Harper, of Hallamshire H., with T. Kay (Tipton H ) and Cotterell (3rd Signals) second and third.

And so he arrived at Mitcham, still fighting gallantly and almost "all-in," in the tenth position, but well within striking distance of those in front, now led by Tipton H., due to a fine run by their International, T.
Allum caught the International, T. Kay, of Tipton, only to have to let him go again in the last few yards, but now we were fourth again and within three seconds of the third position.
